gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-yi: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies bends its strokes like thin tubing looped back on itself. Noto Sans Yi is the opposite, with a deep lowercase midsection and rounds left open like an unlatched hook.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-za: Loopy, bent-tube letters with bowls that nearly seal shut: that is Jelly Crazies, wobbling along at a leisurely walk. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square stands tall and open beside it.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-traditi: Noto Traditional Nushu writes with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut. Jelly Crazies is the wobbly foil, a display face with no pen modulation at all, and its bowls almost close.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-numans: Numans spreads its lowercase wide, with tracking pushed far past normal. Jelly Crazies is the wobbly one, with bowls nearly sealed and a pace that slows right down, while Numans stays modern and clean.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-onest: Onest keeps short ascenders above big, open bowls, drawn in a gentle monotone of line thickness, which is a pleasing change from the wobble of Jelly Crazies. Shrink the heading and its closed bowls clog.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-orienta: Orienta is a modern, plain sans whose counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open, with little height difference between cases. Beside Jelly Crazies, it would read quietly.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-oxygen: Wobbly tubes meet tidy curves. Jelly Crazies has no modulation between stems and connecting strokes, while Oxygen sets lowercase nearly matching its capitals and never closes its curves back on themselves.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness everywhere, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk. Parkinsans gives the wobbly, nearly sealed bowls of Jelly Crazies something steady to lean against on the page.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-pathway-extr: Playful through and through, Jelly Crazies draws true monoline loops with bowls that nearly seal. Pathway Extreme handles the quieter job, with clear openings in its rounds and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-preahvihear: Jelly Crazies draws constant-width arms and legs, with bowls that nearly seal shut and a pace that slows to a stroll. Preahvihear does the opposite, an open letter mouth like a pried oyster shell.
